text: XXIV. 1. Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Mahācundo Cetīsu viharati Sahajātiyaṃ. Tatra kho āyasmā Mahācundo bhikkhū āmantesi:-- Āvuso bhikkhavo ti. Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahācundassa paccassosuṃ. Ñāṇavādaṃ āvuso bhikkhu vadamāno ‘jānām'; imaṃ dhammaṃ passām'; imaṃ dhamman'; ti. Tañ ce āvuso bhikkhuṃ lobho abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati, doso . . . pe . . . moho . . . kodho . . . upanāho . . . makkho . . . paḷāso . . . macchariyaṃ . . . pāpikā issā . . . pāpikā icchā abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati, so evam assa veditabbo: Na ayam āyasmā tathā pajānāti, yathā pajānato lobho na hoti; tathā h'; imaṃ āyasmantaṃ lobho abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati.
